pull_request.title: Documentation: Describe trimmed mixed preliminary pixel baseline in TDR
pull_request.head: codex/pixel-baseline-tdr
pull_request.body:
This self-contained pixel TDR edition is rebased onto the PR55 receiving branch. It documents the trimmed mixed single/quad pixel endcap and retains the original 11-page manuscript, drawings, compiled preview and validation evidence.

The rebase preserves all scientific inputs and native execution hashes. Twelve source files from the original compiled revision are bundled with their original SHA-256 pins so later baseline changes cannot silently alter this frozen edition. Source verification rejects modified snapshots. The later full-tracker Overleaf chapter remains a separate publication.

Validation: frozen-source and mutation controls passed; generated tables, facts and figure hashes match; dashboard and session logger validate and build; full main-relative whitespace check passed. CI recompiles the manuscript with pdfLaTeX. Original pre-rebase head is retained in codex/archive/pr45-pre-rebase-20261007. No design sign-off is implied.

Merge order: PR55 into main, then PR45, then PR47, followed by the separate logging synchronization PR. The stacked bases preserve independent tracking changes and avoid merge conflicts.
